data_kind: synthetic center-sampled material labels, not measured grayscale images

evaluation.free_surface_rule: Clip all reference, voxel, P and T segments to Y >= input-inferred contact height + 2h; report this band separately from complete closed-section distances
evaluation.voxel_agreement: all input voxel centers; material1 vs rest
evaluation.ranking: report every profile; do not select or tune on hidden reference

limits: Researchers know this is a stripe family; input isolation is not a researcher double-blind study.
P and T_MC are complete reconstruction pipelines, not a comparison of storage formats alone.
No original parameters, stripe centers, supplied contour partitions, or original observations enter reconstruction.
The original continuous reference is available only to the separate evaluator.
Topology unsupported by the selected P parameterization must be rejected rather than repaired silently.
No full-Mark scalability claim or raw-image segmentation validation is made.
